# Basic Props

基础展示与低级交互组件。 共 1 个组件。字段细节以 `packages/core/src/types/*.ts` 为准；跨包组件以本段列出的源码为准。

## Kbd

`packages/core/src/types/kbd.ts` · `KbdProps` · 4/7 compact props · [Complete props](#remaining-props-complete-public-api)

Note: 组合键留在原生 `kbd` 的可见文本里（例如 `Ctrl + K`），根节点不设 `aria-label`。`variant` 的 default 是 Kbd 自己的底/边/字色，不是可点 Tag。

| Prop         | Type         | Default     | Notes                                                                                      |
| ------------ | ------------ | ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `keys?`      | `KbdKeys`    | `-`         | One key or a combo list. A string is a single key; an array is joined with `separator`.... |
| `separator?` | `string`     | `'+'`       | Separator between combo keys                                                               |
| `size?`      | `KbdSize`    | `'md'`      | Visual size                                                                                |
| `variant?`   | `KbdVariant` | `'default'` | Visual variant. `default` is Kbd chrome (bg/text/border); `subtle` is quieter.             |

### Remaining props (complete public API)

- `className?`: `string`; default `-`. Additional CSS classes
- `style?`: `Record<string, unknown>`; default `-`. Inline styles
- `children?`: `React.ReactNode`; default `-`. -
